official_channel.note: robots.txt permits the public search page, but fares are rendered client-side from /api/v1, which robots.txt disallows. Compliant static collection therefore yields no prices — the search URL returns HTTP 200 and 33 KB whose entire visible text is 'Please enable Javascript to view this site'. Note this rules out a headless browser too, not just a static client: rendering the page makes the browser fetch the disallowed /api/v1 itself. Unlike akasaair.com, the blocker here is permission, not engineering.

official_channel.note: robots.txt contains no Disallow at all — every path is permitted. The route page returns HTTP 200 and 353 KB, but carries no fare: no rupee amount appears anywhere in the served document, and the 190 KB __NEXT_DATA__ island holds CMS copy (story, navFooter), not prices. The URL also has no travel-date parameter, so this page shape cannot express T+1/T+7/T+15/T+30 at all. Reaching a priced result means driving the booking form through /searchpanel. Sitemap lists 148 city-pair pages, covering 9 of the 15 basket routes (69.2% of basket weight).
